image-text-card-row.looks: A row of tall cards: a picture at the top (often a document cover), an optional small icon, a title, a subtitle, a paragraph and a link, on a warm grey panel. A small-image style puts a cover thumbnail at the top left instead.
image-text-card-row.use: Publications, briefs or reports, each with a cover image and a link.
image-text-card-row.avoid: No images: use Multi Icn Btn Col Card Grid.

fields.imageStyle: default: the picture fills the top of the card. small: a 141x183 thumbnail at the top left, for document covers.
fields.imageAlign: Which part of a cropped picture stays visible: center (default), left or right.

fields.image: A cover or photo for the top of the card.
fields.icon: Optional small icon by the title.
fields.title: The publication's name.
fields.subtitle: Optional short line, e.g. the year or type.
fields.linkText: The link's words, e.g. 'Read the Brief'.
fields.cardContentBg: Panel colour under the picture; empty keeps warm grey.
